items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I married his cousin... we played together... we learned together. We wear the same clothes.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know his family. He came out of John's source, he raised up with him. Yeah, yeah. I married his cousin. You married his cousin?

Yeah, I married his cousin and we, we played together and his father, we was learning together, me and him. So he was playing routine and I learned him the music. Yeah. I learned him the music. He was playing routine and I learned him the music and so him and Nussie Rubin was playing, had a professor over here from the French opera. Where did you see that? No, right here. You know the French opera they had, yeah. Yeah, Rubin and Toulouse. Yeah, well he used to come over here and take lessons, Nussie Rubin, with…
Right behind the Naval Station. Right behind the Naval Station.
